correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact second-order resolvent expansions give the matrix mean defect h^2 Q/2 and ordering increment h^2 J/2. Contractivity yields a deterministic uniform O(h) pathwise approximation, and an orthogonal martingale decomposition has an O(h^(5/2)) L2 approximation error by independent leading Rademacher increments. Lindeberg-Feller and a 2h-mesh Riemann sum prove the h^(3/2) CLT and exact 1/8 covariance coefficient; a separate iid expansion proves its h^(1/2) counterpart. The 2D sharpness uses invertibility of each nonzero planar skew commutator. Exact rational Taylor identities and all 2^n order sequences for n<=5 agree with moment recursions; numerical covariance limits approach the analytic integrals. Risk: only fixed finite dimension, PSD symmetry and exact solves are covered.

value.rationale: PASS: Balanced-per-pair work scheduling is a natural variance-control design for decomposed gradient flows. At an identical cost of 2N resolvent evaluations, the covariance scale improves from h to h^3, and an exact commutator limit says when any ordering variability survives. A positive-definite noncommuting 2-by-2 example establishes sharpness. This distinguishes a scientifically relevant stochastic-cancellation mechanism from ordinary first-order backward-Euler bias without claiming total-error superconvergence or nonlinear generality.
